semantics.C01: IDs never reused. Business semantic version != optimistic edit revision != Directus revision log. Published immutable; new meaning gets new version. Activation belongs binding, not implicit on publish. IDs and lifecycle validated in shape; transition/immutability in PG proof.
semantics.C02: Client context is selector/prefill only. Server resolves authenticated actor, permissions, parent+slot+revision and runtime instance; reject mismatch. Delegation is current authority, never a frozen grant. not-runtime/none are explicit N/A values, not omitted facts.
semantics.C03: One envelope for Human/Agent/service. Caller cannot choose physical table/profile/authority; transport request is subset, response populates result/readback/evidence/error. Parameters validated by selected action profile, never free to write arbitrary columns. Receipt(actor,key,payload hash) shares transaction with effect/audit; same key different payload conflict; read authority rechecked on replay.
semantics.C04: Compare exact meaning/type/unit/owner/operation, not similar labels. Candidate != admitted. Unknown meaning/owner -> NEEDS_DECISION, no auto-create. Lazy stable mapping unique physical address + semantic version; usage separately recorded. Coverage denominator is requested facets, not relevance score. No Qdrant/vector project.

semantics.C06: Resolve transitive closure and type refs at publish; capture semantic keys only, exclude identity grants/secrets/cache. Digest detects drift, does not authorize. Evidence pins exact revision+closure. Activation CAS selects approved release; admission atomically resolves active binding to instance. Current permission deny overrides execution, never reinterprets semantics. Missing old implementation fails closed. Snapshot mechanism in lab does not mean production release table approved.
semantics.C07: Occurrence UNIQUE + payload hash; duplicate same event reuses instance/job, changed payload conflicts. case is grouping, never dedup key. One-MOT slice task_instance_id==instance_id permitted explicit mapping; multi-task cardinality NEW_REQUIRED before expansion. Queue delivery/retry/ACK exclusively pg-boss; receipt/effect one PG transaction. Output incomplete cannot ACK business completion. Transport can redeliver, effect remains idempotent.
semantics.C08: Code/category/retry coherence checked with declaration allowlist and actual P3; explicit known transient only auto-retries; permission waits/denies; unsupported code defaults terminal investigation. Network failure after dispatch is unknown, not transient. Reconcile authorized read receipt+effect; committed -> confirm, absent needs safe evidence before resume with same effect key.
semantics.C09: Test != Review != Approve != Publish != Activate. Policy decides required actions/risk/SoD/expiry/revocation; no real approver inferred. Material/dependency/revision change stales prior evidence. Publish creates immutable version, activation changes binding only. Test fixture evidence never human acceptance.
semantics.C10: Append-only audit semantics, no secrets/PII in errors. Business effect+receipt/native audit same transaction. Rejected action log persists separately without false business effect. Correlation connects intent through output/reconcile. Other governed write lanes need equivalent contract; no universal Directus-only rule.
